title: My friend Jim Henderson – stirring up more trouble for a good cause
excerpt: Jim – among his many creative endeavors – tries to get unlikely people to listen to each other. Through churchrater.com , he’s getting Christian leaders to listen to young atheists. And the reverse too, come to think of it.
